title: Coarse composition suffices: tabular in-context learning for multi-activity antimicrobial peptide profiling
abstract: arXiv:2608.30337v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) often act against multiple pathogen classes, making multi-label activity prediction a more realistic screening target than binary antimicrobial classification. The ESCAPE benchmark formalizes this setting, but leading approaches typically rely on multimodal, structure-conditioned deep models that are costly to train and tune. We show that a simple, sequence-only pipeline can match and surpass these methods by combining 330 interpretable sequence descriptors with TabPFN, a tabular foundation model that performs in-context prediction in a single forward pass without gradient-based training or hyperparameter search. On ESCAPE (82,359 peptides; five labels), a label-powerset TabPFN model achieves mAP-5 = 77.8%, improving on the previously best reported 72.1%. translated_title: 粗粒度组成特征足矣：用于多活性抗菌肽谱分析的表格上下文学习
translated_abstract: 抗菌肽（AMPs）通常对多种病原体类别具有活性，这使得多标签活性预测比二元抗菌分类更符合实际的筛选目标。ESCAPE基准将这一设定形式化，但领先的方法通常依赖于多模态、结构条件化的深度模型，其训练和调优成本高昂。我们证明，一个简单的、仅基于序列的流程可以通过将330个可解释的序列描述符与TabPFN（一种表格基础模型，可在单次前向传播中完成上下文内预测，无需基于梯度的训练或超参数搜索）相结合，来匹配并超越这些方法。在ESCAPE基准（82,359条肽；五个标签）上，标签幂集（label-powerset）TabPFN模型实现了mAP-5 = 77.8%，优于此前报告的最佳结果72.1%。概率分类器链方法则首次在全部五个标签上同时达到或超过已发表的最佳平均精度。
tldr: 该研究证明，仅用330个可解释序列描述符结合无需梯度训练的TabPFN表格基础模型，即可在ESCAPE多标签抗菌肽活性预测基准上超越复杂的多模态深度模型，将mAP-5从72.1%提升至77.8%。
en_tdlr: A simple sequence-only pipeline combining 330 interpretable descriptors with TabPFN, a tabular foundation model requiring no gradient-based training, surpasses costly multimodal deep models on the ESCAPE multi-label antimicrobial peptide benchmark, improving mAP-5 from 72.1% to 77.8%.
